favourite.heading: Why Kansas State can pull away
bullets: Kansas State is the better football team by 6.4 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (-6.4 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Cincinnati can keep it close
bullets: Playing at Cincinnati is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -25.3 to p90 +18.7 for Cincinnati, so a projection of -2.3 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
